item.title: BUILD HENDERSONVILLE NEW PARTICIPATORY BUDGET PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF HENDERSONVILLE
item.description: – The City of Hendersonville is making its budget process moreinteractive than ever with the launch of a new participatory budgeting program called BuildHendersonville. The City is setting aside $25,000 for residents to decide how the funds should be used to improve thecommunity. item.title: SECOND WEEK OF WINTER CLEANUP CONTINUES IN HENDERSON COUNTY AS CREWS BATTLE FRIGID WINDS
item.description: In Henderson County, from the North Carolina Department of Transportation to private contractor crews, it was the second week of winter weather cleanup. To give crews more time to make primary and secondary roadways passable, both Henderson County and Hendersonville have closed government offices on Monday, Feb. 2, for non-essential workers. item.title: AREA CANCELLATIONS DUE TO SNOWSTORM UPDATED 2/2/26 AT 8:20 PM
item.description: All campuses of Blue Ridge Community College are closed on Tuesday, Feb. 3, 2026. All classes and scheduled events are canceled due to snow and ice on roadways and walkways from the winter storm. The College remains closed Monday, Feb. 2. Our facilities team is currently working hard to clear snow and ice as quickly as possible to ensure a safe return.
